ask_user.description: 询问一个确定目标所需的问题。

answer.description: 根据实际结果结束本轮；也可以直接在消息正文答复。

get_understanding.description: 读取项目素材分析（概述、论旨、主题、受众、可引用原话），再总结素材或根据素材推荐。若素材仍在处理中，会等到分析就绪才返回，本轮即可据此作答。

get_asset.description: 读取素材的处理状态、语言、时长和开头文本。项目只有一个文件素材时可省略 ID；有多个时返回带 ID 的清单。

search_transcript.description: 按主题检索项目转写文本（确定性关键词检索），返回带起止时间和逐字原文的候选段落，供判断选用。

list_project_media.description: 设计包含上传录像或图片的视频前，先列出项目中可用于合成的素材，含稳定 ID、类型、已知或未知的时长、尺寸及可用性。只引用本项目真实 ID。按最新在前分页，每页 40 条，提示中给出旧记录的偏移。可直接传入所选 ID 读取确切素材，不受页数限制。

prepare_video_materials.description: 准备所选网页，并导入选定素材、已交付视频或曲库音乐以供剪辑。等待 URL 采集完成。结果含当前所有者范围内的 SourceSnapshot 标识，可用作工具参数。视频默认提供有限的代表静帧，不能据此声称连续审片。仅用户明确要求连续检查源视频时用 video_observation=continuous。search_music 或 select_music 返回的 Music ID 传入 material_music_ids，不传 material_asset_ids。只返回已完成资源或明确失败，不返回待处理。复用已导入的媒体，后续设计被拒绝不影响已准备好的资源。只读现有媒体，不合成或渲染。

generate_image.description: Create and review one image. Returns the actual pixels and a fixed project source.

generate_voice.description: Record the exact script at original speed. Return playable audio, measured duration and alignment status.

generate_music.description: Generate a playable electronic instrumental of the requested length. Returns measured audio for later editing.

review_video.description: 对照用户要求审阅指定的已交付视频 Output。系统解码该 Output 自身的文件，附带真实采样帧及时间，检查绑定版本，保存建议性报告。默认复用已有报告，refresh=true 可重新执行所选采样模式。按指定时点复查用 at_seconds；审阅某个已执行 Scene 的有序帧用 motion_scene_id。二者互斥。声称看过成片或应要求做内容质量修订前，先用本工具。不要用分镜读取结果或最近的其他 Output 替代。

align_recording.description: Align the exact transcript with an explicitly referenced recording.

get_narration_alignment.description: 读取归属当前用户的 NarrationAlignment 的实际状态及完整数据，包括句词范围、整数刻度、插值、审阅状态和语义。不要估算缺失时间。

annotate_narration.description: 为 ALIGNED 旁白逐句标注 role、weight、entities、needs 和 emphasis_word_ids，词 ID 取自本句实际单词。原样带回本次读取的 expected_timing_digest。文本和刻度不可变。全部句子对齐并标注后才能达到 READY。

read_conversation_context.description: 读取因上下文预算而省略的历史工具调用及其实际结果。使用 CONVERSATION TOOL HISTORY 列出的条目 ID，或以空 item_ids 和 cursor 翻页。读取历史不会重做原操作或执行其参数。

create_video.description: Create the first editable version from ordered shots. A title card only needs headline, duration_seconds and text_color. Save without exporting. 本轮旁白已固定，保存画面后可用 insert_audio 放入原音。未绑定外部 Skill，不使用 skill_resource。

extend_still.description: Extend the closing static image, shape or title by additional seconds. Other tracks retain their duration.

bind_clip_source.description: Bind a fixed project snapshot to a pending voice or image clip. Preserve timing and layout; inspect the saved version before export.

insert_audio.description: Place fixed audio on the current timeline at original speed. Set the level using gain_db.

inspect_timeline.description: Read clips in timeline order, their tracks, scene numbers, source windows and spatial object IDs.

inspect_clip.description: Inspect one clip, its layout, transform, animation properties and same-track neighbors on the current version.

split_clip.description: Split a clip and its linked media at a clip-local second. Save one version.

trim_clip.description: Keep a subrange measured from this clip's start. Crop linked fixed sources at 1x, leave gaps, keep other clips in place. Reject broken transitions or loss of a linked member.

move_clip.description: Set a clip's start on the timeline, moving its linked clips equally. Preserve duration and source window, leave gaps. Reject same-track collisions, broken transitions and scene escape.

translate.description: Set one visual object's static offset relative to its layout box. Preserve other objects and time. Reject an animated position.

scale.description: Set one visual object's static scale around its existing origin. Preserve other objects, including subtitles. Reject animated scale.

preview_range.description: Play the current composition across all tracks and cuts. Specify start and end seconds from the beginning (up to 12 seconds).

deliver_video.description: Attach the reviewed MP4 to this conversation when ready to hand it to the user.

export_video.description: Export the selected, previewed version as a formal MP4. Returns the exact Output for review.

parameters.description: 对照用户明确的要求审阅一个确切的已交付 Output。

output_id.description: 从视频卡片或 @output 引用取得的确切已交付视频 Output ID，不默认指向作品最近的 Output。
output_id.title: Output Id

at_seconds.description: 需要检查的具体成片时点。提供后按这些时点取样，尤其适用于复核先前发现。
at_seconds.title: At Seconds

motion_scene_id.description: 此 Output 已执行 render_spec 中的确切 Scene ID，用于一段有序运动帧审阅，不取 Composition 最新版本中的场景。与 at_seconds 互斥。
motion_scene_id.title: Motion Scene Id

refresh.description: true 表示重新解码并审阅；false 在已有报告时复用此确切 Output 的报告。新 Output 须独立审阅。
refresh.title: Refresh

pending_disposition.description: 有待回答问题时，'answer' 表示回应原问题，'skip' 表示明确拒答，'none' 表示明显无关的插话。
pending_disposition.title: Pending Disposition

parameters.title: ReviewVideoArgs
